sources.title: T-Hunts
sources.purpose: Year index and detail-page router for regular Treasure Hunt identification.
sources.observedCoverage: Year links from 1995 through 2026; current-year detail pages carry mix and marker detail.

freshness.basis: Current-year chase indexes can change as mixes are revealed.

sources.provisionalHandling: Require visible package evidence and an independent trusted source before verified TH status.
sources.permittedUse: Normalize individual facts and recognition cues with source attribution; do not reproduce the index.

sources.title: Hot Wheels Treasure Hunt Sets
sources.purpose: Historical reference for annual boxed Treasure Hunt and Super Treasure Hunt sets.

freshness.basis: Historical set facts are comparatively stable but new annual sets and corrections are possible.

sources.provisionalHandling: Confirm edition size, original price, and included vehicles with Mattel, the certificate, or original packaging.
sources.permittedUse: Use individual historical facts with attribution; ignore affiliate listing prices and do not reproduce annual descriptions.

sources.title: Hot Wheels Chase Cars
sources.purpose: Car Culture premium chase index and detail-page router.
sources.observedCoverage: Car Culture 0/5 chase entries from 2022 through 2026.

freshness.basis: Current-year premium mixes and product details are actively updated.

sources.provisionalHandling: Cross-check the exact product code, 0/5 position, set, color/livery, base, and wheels; editorial collisions remain provisional.
sources.permittedUse: Normalize item-level chase candidates and recognition markers with attribution; do not reproduce descriptions or images.

sources.title: Treasure Hunt Checklist
sources.purpose: Cross-year discovery and completeness checklist for regular and Super Treasure Hunts.
sources.observedCoverage: 1995 to present; partial 2027 Super list and 2026 regular/Super sections visible at retrieval.

freshness.basis: Future and current-year lists can be incomplete while releases are revealed.

sources.provisionalHandling: Future, partial, or incomplete-looking sections are discovery candidates only; absence never proves nonexistence.
sources.permittedUse: Use names and year/type membership as leads with attribution; resolve exact identity through detail and package evidence.

sources.title: Hot Wheels Glossary
sources.purpose: Collector vocabulary for wheel types, paint, symbols, clubs, and historical terms.
sources.observedCoverage: Non-year-specific terms including low-production symbol, Real Riders, Spectraflame, Red Line Club, Redline, and wheel abbreviations.

freshness.basis: Terminology is relatively stable; definitions and wheel vocabulary can still be corrected or expanded.

sources.provisionalHandling: Retain the full term with an abbreviation because abbreviations can be context-dependent; use as vocabulary, not identity proof.
sources.permittedUse: Create a normalized internal vocabulary with short derived definitions and attribution; do not copy glossary prose or images.

sources.title: Hot Wheels Casting Database
sources.purpose: Casting/tooling name, debut-year, and designer reference.
sources.observedCoverage: Broad historical casting index with visible debut years through 2026, organized by modeled-vehicle decade and alphabet.

freshness.basis: Historical tooling data is stable but new castings and corrections are added.

sources.provisionalHandling: Use casting plus debut year and detail evidence; identical names can refer to distinct tools and must not be merged by name alone.
sources.permittedUse: Normalize casting name, debut year, and designer with attribution; do not copy the database or source images.

sources.title: 2026 Hot Wheels MASTER LIST of all lines
sources.purpose: Working current-year release-line, assortment, mix, set, and channel tracker.
sources.observedCoverage: 2026 premium, Silver Series, Mattel Creations/ultra-premium, basics, and extensions; page labeled updated 2026-08-21.

freshness.basis: The current-year master list changes as products, mixes, and sale dates are confirmed.

sources.provisionalHandling: Treat starred names, blank cells, TBD dates, upcoming sections, and product-line mix ambiguity as provisional or unknown.
sources.permittedUse: Normalize individual lineup facts with attribution and independent verification; do not reproduce tables, photos, or affiliate links.

sources.title: 2027 Hot Wheels MASTER LIST of all lines
sources.purpose: Early future-year watchlist for release lines, assortments, mixes, sets, and channels.
sources.observedCoverage: Partial 2027 premium, Silver Series, Mattel Creations/ultra-premium, basics, and extensions; many rows blank at retrieval.

freshness.basis: The page was newly published and is a sparse future-year working list.

sources.provisionalHandling: All 2027 entries remain provisional until supported by packaging or an authoritative announcement; ignore blank and starred fields as asserted facts.
sources.permittedUse: Create attributed watchlist candidates only; do not reproduce tables, images, descriptions, or affiliate links.
